title: AlloyDB Autoscaling Adds Connection Count Metric
summary: AlloyDB read pool autoscaling now supports scaling based on the number of active connections. This new `ConnectionsCount` policy allows you to define a `targetCount` for connections, providing more fine-grained control over read replica scaling.
details: The `Policy` schema for AlloyDB read pool autoscaling has been extended with an optional `connectionsCount` property. This new property references the `ConnectionsCount` schema, which includes a `targetCount` field of type `string` (formatted as `int64`). Developers can now configure their read pools to scale up or down to maintain a desired number of connections, complementing the existing CPU utilization and schedule-based autoscaling options.
